name: Succubus Kiss

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Absalom, City of Lost Omens

text:
Activate 1 Interact

---

The save for addiction to succubus kiss is DC 28 Fortitude save, and the addiction has the virulent trait.

Saving Throw DC 24 Fortitude save

Onset 1 minute

Maximum Duration 8 hours

Stage 1 +2 item bonus to initiative checks (10 minutes) and to all saving throws against emotion and mental effects

Effect: Succubus Kiss (Stage 1)

Stage 2 as stage 1 plus Drained 1 (1 hour)

Effect: Succubus Kiss (Stage 2)

Stage 3 as stage 2 plus Blindness or Deafness (1 hour)

Stage 4 blindness and deafness (1 hour)

Stage 5 Unconscious
